mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is computed as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS and is always active.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a labor market slowdown that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between inflation (CPIAUCSL) and monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) drives equity returns: when inflation is rising and the federal funds rate is low, it signals a 'transitory inflation' environment that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the product of the 3-month change in CPIAUCSL and the current FEDFUNDS rate.
failure_condition: The interaction signal shows Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 60% of interaction signal instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a supply-side slowdown that reduces corporate capacity utilization and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only during this regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000.0, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1000.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth is strong (PAYEMS > 135000.0) and unemployment is low (UNRATE < 5.0%), it signals a tight labor market that increases corporate labor costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active only when both conditions hold.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (PAYEMS > 135000.0 AND UNRATE < 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only during this regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 400000.0 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 400000.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
